basis: The PWA only accepts ws:// for localhost/loopback; remote relays require wss://.
The app.js relay setup also includes a local-only ws://127.0.0.1:7447 shortcut with a local-computer notice.
The i18n matches are help/error strings and local relay examples.
Geode operator docs require loopback binding and a TLS-terminating reverse proxy for public access.
groups.residual: An operator who overrides the bind host and exposes the plain WebSocket port can expose relay traffic without TLS. The supported public setup is loopback plus a TLS proxy; this risk is documented in the English and PT-BR relay instructions.
